name: Dropdown / Listbox
summary: A styled select that keeps a real <select> underneath as its value store, so forms and existing change handlers keep working.
demoNote: The panel anchors to its trigger at every width, and flips above it when there is no room below. For a panel that rises from the bottom of the screen, see the Drawer component.

contract.useWhen: A custom select, for when the native one cannot be styled the way you need.
keyboard: open from the trigger, or choose the focused option
close and carry on tabbing, from the trigger rather than the hidden panel
failureModes: aria-activedescendant rather than real DOM focus, which is unreliable on iOS VoiceOver and TalkBack
the trigger named by its label alone, so the current value is never announced
an optgroup's visible label read twice — it needs aria-hidden once role=group carries the name
a disabled option left with a tabindex, so the keyboard lands on something inert
a div as the trigger, so aria-expanded sits on something with no role
api: AC.createDropdown(select, options) -> { open, close, isOpen, sync, rebuild, element, destroy }
